insight.title: Riverton City Executes 9.4-Second Counterattack
insight.canonical_claim: Riverton City regained possession via interception in the middle third and advanced 46.7 metres through 3 passes or carries before a shot was saved 9.4 seconds later.
insight.why_it_matters: This sequence highlights Riverton City's ability to quickly transition from defense to attack, creating a scoring opportunity in under 10 seconds.
insight.uncertainty: This does not establish whether the counterattack was planned or if the opposition was out of position during the sequence.

audience_variants.commentator: Riverton City swiftly turns defense into attack, advancing 47 metres in just 9.4 seconds before a saved shot!
audience_variants.fan_discover: Riverton City quickly took the ball and shot within 9.4 seconds after moving it 47 metres with 3 passes or carries.
audience_variants.fan_analyst: Riverton City's #10 intercepted in the middle third, then combined 3 passes or carries to cover 46.7 metres, culminating in a shot saved after 9.4 seconds. This rapid transition shows effective ball progression and quick decision-making under pressure.
